project.title: Parity: Differential Testing for PostgreSQL to Db2 Migrations
project.short_description: Proves that SQL returns the same result on PostgreSQL and IBM Db2 by running it on both databases, comparing the rows, letting an agent fix a mismatch, and keeping every proven lesson in Db2.

members.name: Amit Kumar
members.role: Backend, Db2 integration, AI agent workflow

ibm_db2.connector: ibm_db 3.3.0 (direct client and a Linux bridge container for Windows)
features_used: Vector Search (VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) with VECTOR_DISTANCE COSINE)

ai_models: Local model double for offline demos
